target_definition: For a race in the frozen V4 strict walk-forward diagnostics, both MARKET_PLUS_SEVEN_KING and MARKET_PLUS_OUTSIDER assign lower probability to the realized winning TRIO than pure TRIO market.
goal: Test whether V4 both-fail / CHAOS races can be predicted before the result on unseen years.

strict_walk_forward.note: 2023 is label-source only because no strict-prior V4 both-fail label exists for 2022.

feature_sets.STRUCTURE_ONLY: Frozen L1.7 race-shape plus frozen safe Outsider ballot aggregates only.
feature_sets.STRUCTURE_PLUS_TRIO_MARKET_SHAPE: STRUCTURE_ONLY plus full-race TRIO market distribution shape derived without using the winning combination.

model.temperature_calibration: latest prior training year chronological last 20%

evaluation.interpretation: Prediction usefulness requires concentration of failures in high-risk predictions, not merely statistical significance.

speed_policy.cpu_split: Two models run concurrently with half of logical CPUs each.
